docs.title: Rust Mechanical Gears App
docs.text: A mechanical gear app written in Rust. It supports both command-line and WebAssembly (WASM) outputs. It features calculations with gear ratio, pitch diameter, output RPM and center distance.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository.
  2. Install libraries: cargo install wasm-pack
  3. Build CLI: rustc gear-cli.rs -o gear-cli
  4. Build WASM library: cd gear_calculator; wasm-pack build --release
  5. Run the program ./gear-cli or JavaScript code:
import init, { GearTrain } from './gear_calculator/pkg/gear_calculator.js';

async function run() {
  await init();

  const train = new GearTrain(20, 60, 2.0);
  const result = train.calculate(1200);

  console.log(JSON.parse(result));
  // Output: { gear_ratio: 3, driven_rpm: 400, center_distance: 80 }
}

run();

docs.title: Gear Calculator Web App with WASM
docs.text: This is a gear calculator web app with WASM/Rust and HTML/JavaScript.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository.
  2. Change directory: cd gear_calculator
  3. Build WASM library: wasm-pack build --release
  4. Open index.html on your browser and enter input values or click on the canvas.

The program should be working.
